content.title: USMNT 0-2 Portugal: Goals and highlights - National Team Friendlies
content.text: Updated 31/03/2026 20:07 CDT Welcome to this MARCA live blog as the USMNT closes out its March international soccer fixtures against Portugal, with pressure mounting after a defensive collapse against Belgium exposed structural flaws that remain unresolved. That previous outing saw Mauricio Pochettino deploy an aggressive system, which initially worked as Weston McKennie opened the scoring, however, the match quickly unraveled as Belgium surged to three goals in a short stretch. They then added one more later on for a final score of 5-2 highlighted major issues in defensive organization, spacing, and decision making, leaving the US coaching staff with urgent questions to address before facing another elite opponent. A key concern remains the absence of Chris Richards, whose role in stabilizing the backline has become increasingly evident, especially as replacement options have struggled to manage high level attacking pressure. Goalkeeper uncertainty adds another layer of instability, while experienced defenders have found it difficult to cope with quick movement around the box, allowing opponents to dictate play and create chances with relative ease. Midfield protection has also been inconsistent, as Johnny Cardoso was unable to fully compensate for defensive gaps, increasing the need for a more reliable presence in the absence of Tyler Adams. USMNT vs Portugal live latest text updates USMNT vs Portugal start time Kick-off is scheduled for 19:00 ET for those in the United States, with the match set to take place at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, which means a 16:00 PT start for those on the West Coast. The home of the NFL's Atlanta Falcons will provide a high-profile stage for both sides in one of their final fixtures before the 2026 FIFA World Cup takes place in the summer. How to Watch USMNT vs Portugal in the United States Ultimately, this fixture represents a critical benchmark for the US, as a disciplined and cohesive performance could restore confidence, while another defensive lapse would deepen concerns. The match will be broadcast on TNT and truTV in English, alongside Spanish coverage on Telemundo and Universo, while streaming options include HBO Max, Peacock, and FuboTV for broader access.
